customers_say: Customers find the digital lock to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its installation, functionality, and appearance. They appreciate its ease of use and consider it worth the price, while also praising the customer service.

reviews.author: Swati
reviews.title: Secure lock
reviews.body: Secure lock, fit seamlessly as a replacement to my older lock. This is the second Godrejlock I have purchased, very happy with the prompt service. Abhimanyu ji installed the lock professionally and perfectly. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: GA
reviews.title: Great lock. Great service
reviews.body: Sikander was the technician who came to our house. V polite. V efficient I’m glad I bought the Godrej lock.

reviews.author: Raja Guru
reviews.title: Godrej Digital lock
reviews.body: It’s working good , and the customer service also available at any time, with in 3 working days they will come and solve the problems, It’s safe and secure for home main door, recommend to buy this digital lock..
